QuestInfo.name: Maya's Third Collection

QuestInfo.2: I got them all for Maya. I'm still not getting anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??

0.0: Oh... Are you ready? Don't go too fast, though! Okay, would you please get #b10 #t4000026# and 50 of each #t4000023#, #t4000045#, #t4000039##k?

yes.0: Thanks! I think you have to travel all over the places to get these items. If you have collected them all, please get back to me. I will wait right here.

no.0: Oh you must be really busy now... But please get back to me if you have time later. I would like to get the stuff by myself, but I am not fully recovered...

1.0: Wow! You got them all! This one was little bit harder than the last one, right? But Nothing will be hard for you... Anyway, thanks, but they are not enough, though.

yes.0: I got the stuff. Thanks you so much. But I need much more stuff, though... So please get back to me when you are ready.
